instructions: LiteSwitch serves a full or lite lesson page and runs a Flagsmith Experimentation A/B test for slow-connection visitors. Focus reviews on (1) correctness of the Flagsmith experiment logic: exposure, identity and events; (2) security: no secrets or keys committed; (3) accessibility of the lesson page. The owner must be able to explain every file, so prefer simple, commented code.

rules.rule: trackExposureEvent('page_weight') may only be called when flag.experiment.inExperiment === true, once per page view, when the chosen variant is committed to the page. Never use getExperimentFlag (it records at read time) and never record an exposure after the 5 s timeout fallback served the full page.
The flag decision and every event (lesson_started, lesson_completed, page_bytes) must use the same ls_vid visitor id. Visitors who are not enrolled must not send events.
Fast or unknown-connection visitors must get the full page without calling Flagsmith, so they never enter the experiment. The ?net= override must only work when NEXT_PUBLIC_SIM_MODE is 1.
Event names must stay exactly lesson_started, lesson_completed and page_bytes; they must match the Flagsmith metric names character for character.
No secrets, API keys, tokens or .env files may be committed. The Flagsmith key is read only from NEXT_PUBLIC_FLAGSMITH_ENVIRONMENT_KEY; flag any hardcoded key or server-side secret.
Interactive elements must be real buttons with accessible names, images need meaningful alt text, disabled or loading states must be visible as text, and video controls must stay keyboard reachable.
